# Resolve the prerequisites for independent orchestration review

## What & Why
Documentary readiness finding only, not another installer or the independent package/plan verifier. The canonical Paired package and full 18-piece replacement are delivered by #102, but the referenced canonical skill-install-confirmation companion and native finalized-primary/attachment evidence are missing/unverified. Do not execute verification or claim this proposal attaches the verifier.

## Done looks like
Read the complete docs/validation/paired-task-orchestration-verification-plan.md, installer handoff, manifest and native readback, plus canonical Router/Paired contracts. Resolve the confirmation companion through canonical .agents only or report its exact unavailable obligation. Obtain the narrow user batching decision for a distinct SKILL.md-only confirmation alongside resource/plan verification, without creating hidden tasks. Identify the actual permitted host finalized-primary/readback/attachment route, dependency delivery semantics and cooperative concurrency limits using bounded allowed documentary evidence. Do not infer finalization from assignment/hash/status or invent APIs.

Deliver docs/validation/paired-task-orchestration-readiness.md with genuine source/binding/evidence, satisfied versus blocked prerequisites, actual owner/action and exact continuation. If missing evidence remains, report BLOCKED. Only after actual finalized-primary, companion/batching and permitted creation route are established may an authorized continuation attach the complete independent payload with real #102 dependency, full primary/verifier bracketing readback and normalized key. This task itself grants no native verifier creation, verification acceptance or FG-02 preparation.

## Out of scope
No package edits, substitute/mirror skill, native attachment/status change, recursive verifier, runtime grants/store access, imports/tests/builds/hooks/services/signals/CI/recovery/cutover/deploy. Existing full FG-02 g02 drafts remain pending actual independent acceptance and fresh native full-plan binding; no later-piece cards.

## Validation
Readback-only / execution not authorized. UNKNOWN governance is not INACTIVE permission. Missing authority is a finding, never reusable allowance.

## Regression Guard
Self-satisfying fixed prerequisite source/readback finding; no runtime change.
